*"A reminder the user asked for stays scheduled until the user cancels it."*

1. **The user explicitly asked for a reminder** (i.e., a friendly message about returning a borrowed item).  
2. **The reminder will remain scheduled until the user explicitly cancels it** (i.e., no automatic expiration).

These two conditions form a single group (no "OR" alternatives are mentioned).
